entries.title: Zephaniah 2:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Gather yourselves - Call a solemn assembly, proclaim a fast. Not desired - Or, not desirous. Unwilling to return, and unworthy to be received on your return.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:2
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The decree - Before God's decree is put in execution. The day - Before the day of your calamities. As the chaff - Carry you away as the wind carries chaff away.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Seek - Fear, worship, depend on him alone. Ye meek - Ye humble ones. Wrought his judgment - Obeyed his precepts. Seek righteousness - Continue therein. Seek meekness - Patiently wait on the just and merciful God. Hid - Under the wing of Divine Providence.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: For - It is time to seek God; for your neighbours, as well as you, shall be destroyed. Gaza - A chief city of the Philistines. They - The Babylonians. Shall drive - Into captivity. At the noon day - It shall be taken by force at noon.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The inhabitants - All the Philistines. Cherethites - Or destroyers, men that were stout, fierce, and terrible to their neighbours. O Canaan - That part that the Philistines kept by force from the Jews.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:6
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: For shepherds - Instead of cities full of rich citizens, there shall be only cottages for shepherds.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The coast - The sea - coast, the land of the Philistines. The remnant - That survive the captivity. Shall feed - Their flocks. In the houses - In places where these formerly stood. They - Both shepherds and flocks. Shall visit - In mercy.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:9
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Of nettles - Not cultivated, but over - run with nettles. Salt - pits - A dry, barren earth, fit only to dig salt out of. The residue - That return out of Babylon. Possess them - Settle upon those parts of their lands, that are fit for habitation.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:11
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Famish - Take away all their sacrifices and drink - offerings. The gods - Idols of those lands. From his place - Not only at Jerusalem, but every where.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:12
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: By my sword - The Chaldeans are called God's sword; because God employed them.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:13
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: He - God. The north - Assyria, which lay northward of Judea, and due north from Babylon.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:14
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: All the beasts - All sorts of beasts which are found in those countries. The bittern - A bird that delights in desolate places.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:15
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: This - So the prophet triumphs over her. There is none - None like me, or that can contend with me.
